capabilities: apply colored ==text=={Color} highlights via a floating selection toolbar
erase highlights by placing the cursor inside them, no exact selection needed
attach hand-drawn margin annotations to colored highlights with routed arrows
configure arrow direction and per-annotation visual randomness
keep highlights as plain Markdown that survives sync and copy-paste
disambiguation: Not just colored text; it also renders hand-drawn margin notes beside highlights, linked by arrows.
extras: Fork of an existing plugin; the README defers demo, original feature details, and changelog to the original Highlightr repository. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Annotations have documented limits: no } or line breaks inside notes, avoid use inside tables, and Markdown inside notes shows as plain text in Reading mode.
intentEvidence: This is an active fork of chetachi's original Highlightr Plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to highlight text in chosen colors, and the original Highlightr plugin injected HTML instead of native Markdown.
